stage: independent preparation only; no candidate or approval
independence: Written after directly inspecting this object's original.png, fixed target.png, warm-soft-reference.png and actual original native collection; no editor proposal or another object's aesthetic criteria was read.

observations.original: A straight blue barrier with a shallow visible top and an almost rectangular front. Its very flat broad horizontal tone bands turn the lower front nearly black and leave little readable stone volume. Bright cyan top contrasts strongly with the dark base. This is visible weakness, not a hard design constraint.
observations.target: A compact blue stone barrier built visually from several large rounded/faceted interlocking rock masses. Broad cyan upper faces, cobalt front facets and restrained dark crevices produce readable volume. There are only a few small stones. The target's bright contour gleams and very deep creases should not become directional highlights, black outlines or tiny noisy detail. The target is a design guide, not proof of source profile, camera, root or half-width clearance.
observations.styleReference: The plant demonstrates clean saturated palette separation, broad soft gradients over legible planes and rounded manufactured edges, with small bright highlight zones. Its green/orange colors and pot construction do not transfer to this blue terrain object.
observations.native: Actual original collection S33_PROP_rock-half-width.001 contains a root empty and a single 36-vertex/32-polygon core mesh with no modifiers. Root is identity. Mesh dimensions are 1 x 0.3400000036 x 0.9419825077, already disproving a universal opaque full-square ground shape. Native root declares W/E ports and static metadata; evaluated finite profile, contact and actual temporal-channel audit still need measurement. Collection is saved hidden and the active camera/frame are unrelated to the declared registered record.
observations.modelingFreedom: Better native stone volumes, construction and purposeful sparse detail are desirable within the measured physical/connection contract. The single core, part count, flat bands and nearly black lower face are not locks.

priorityOutcomes: Readable rounded stone volumes and cobalt/cyan face separation at logical and phone size
Soft broad nondirectional highlights with a legible blue base and no black dead band
Coherent native surface treatment across all four facings and genuinely continuous finite W/E joins
